title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-4n5v: Ack::from_bytes accepts n > MAX_WINDOW_SIZE on ACKs with no trailing ones
description:
Severity: P2 (rejects valid ACK)

`Ack::from_bytes_for` at `fragment.rs:347` checks `n > MAX_WINDOW_SIZE` where `MAX_WINDOW_SIZE = 62` and `WINDOW_SIZE = 63`. When an ACK has no trailing ones (i.e. all 63 fragments in the window are missing), the sender computes `n = WINDOW_SIZE - trailing = 63 - 0 = 63`.

The receiver then rejects the valid `n=63` value as `FragmentError::MalformedAck` because `63 > 62`.

The check should use `WINDOW_SIZE` not `MAX_WINDOW_SIZE` to match the valid range of the SCHC N field (6 bits, 0-63). The bitmap width is 63 (FCN 0-62), and n=63 signals "all 63 bits present, none trailing."

**Fix:** Change `n > MAX_WINDOW_SIZE` to `n > WINDOW_SIZE`.

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs`, line 347.
